context: Yuki explains a membership program to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business briefing; vocabulary (会員/民間/指定/協会/組合) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新しい会員制度を、ご説明します。
lines.en: I'll explain the new membership system.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会員は、どこから集めるのかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 民間の協会と、組んで集めます。
lines.en: We'll recruit with a private association.
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 指定の窓口は、設けるのかね?
lines.en: Will we set up a designated desk?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、指定の窓口を設けます。
lines.en: Yes, we'll set up a designated desk.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 組合とも、連携できるのかね?
lines.en: Can we coordinate with the union too?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 組合と協会、両方と連携します。
lines.en: We'll coordinate with both union and association.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 民間の力を、うまく使おう。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
